## Profile

**Name:** Javier Boix Campos
**Role:** ML Engineer | Efficient AI & Biomedical Applications
**Location:** Spain
**Email:** javierboixcampos@gmail.com
**Website:** https://jboixcampos.github.io/

**Summary:** ML Engineer with 3+ years of experience across industry and research. Compressed a computer vision model from 258 MB to 8 MB using quantum-inspired tensorization, a result published commercially and validated across 20,780 samples. Previously a Bioinformatics Research Scientist at UKE Hamburg with publications in Science Advances and JACC, I am the Curator of the WEF Valencia Hub and creator of Vivum. I graduated as Valedictorian of my Master's in Data Analysis and top of my class in Biotechnology.

## Professional Experience

### ML Engineer — Multiverse Computing
**Period:** Dec 2025 – Present
**Location:** Madrid, Spain
- Compressed a proprietary computer vision model from 258 MB to 8 MB (96.8%) using quantum-inspired tensorization and quantization — 1.91× throughput, 49% less energy per inference, SSIM 0.97 validated on 20,780 samples. Delivered one month ahead of deadline; published on the company blog and became a commercial selling point.
- Developed and deployed production ML pipelines across multiple concurrent projects, including experiment tracking with MLflow, containerisation with Docker, and cloud infrastructure on AWS.

### Bioinformatics Research Scientist (Deep Learning) — Sáez Lab, University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf (UKE)
**Period:** Jan 2023 – Dec 2025
**Location:** Hamburg, Germany (Hybrid)
- Designed and implemented custom CNN architectures for automated analysis of cell microscopy images, enabling quantitative study of cell migration patterns in complex biological networks.
- Developed end-to-end deep learning pipelines for cell dynamics analysis, including image quality enhancement models, directional migration tracking, and mitochondria quantification systems.
- Applied multivariate statistical methods (PCA, LASSO, ANOVA) to analyse migration patterns in HIV-infected cells, processing thousands of time-lapse microscopy images to identify significant biological patterns.
- Built automated analysis tools that reduce manual image analysis time by 95%+ while improving measurement consistency and reproducibility across experimental conditions.

### Tech Lead — Innovare Genetics
**Period:** Oct 2024 – Dec 2025
**Location:** Madrid, Spain (Hybrid)
- Architected genetic analysis platform from scratch, leading full development lifecycle from research toward CE-IVD/MDR certification and commercial launch.
- Built full-stack solutions including automated analysis pipelines, regulatory documentation systems, and external integrations, establishing the technical foundation for the company's product roadmap.
- Led cross-functional coordination with clinical validators and regulatory bodies to ensure European medical device compliance, managing technical requirements for the CE-IVD/MDR certification process.
- Drove technical strategy and product roadmap planning while managing stakeholder communications and delivery timelines for multi-phase product development.

### AI Developer — Elite Sports 17 S.L.
**Period:** Jul 2024 – Oct 2024
**Location:** Valencia, Spain
- Developed machine learning pipelines for automated sports match analysis, implementing computer vision algorithms for player tracking and performance metrics extraction.
- Built data processing infrastructure to handle real-time video analysis, delivering actionable insights to coaching staff and improving team analytics capabilities.

### Research Intern (Oncogenic Signaling Lab) — Prince Felipe Research Center (CIPF)
**Period:** Nov 2021 – Jul 2022
**Location:** Valencia, Spain
- Conducted Bachelor's Thesis research on proteins involved in lung cancer metastatic processes, investigating molecular mechanisms driving cancer progression on H1395 cells.
- Performed cell culture, western blots, proliferation and wound healing assays across multiple cell lines to characterise protein expression and functional effects.

### Research Intern (Genomics Lab) — Institute for Plant Molecular and Cellular Biology (IBMCP)
**Period:** Mar 2021 – Jul 2021
**Location:** Valencia, Spain
- Isolated and characterised CYCD3;1 gene from Arabidopsis thaliana for cell cycle regulation studies under acid stress conditions.
- Performed genome extractions, molecular cloning (restriction enzyme and Gateway systems), and qRT-PCR for gene expression verification.

### Operations Coordinator (PIAE+ Program) — Polytechnic University of Valencia
**Period:** Sep 2020 – Jul 2022
**Location:** Valencia, Spain
- Managed end-to-end coordination of student accompaniment programme involving 2,000+ students, coordinating workshops, onboarding events, and academic support initiatives.
- Optimised operational workflows and database management systems, improving process efficiency and student satisfaction metrics.

### Member of Biotechnology Academic Committee — Polytechnic University of Valencia

## Projects & Leadership

### Vivum — Open Index for Interactive Scientific Publishing
**Status:** Active (2026–)
**URL:** https://vivum-pub.org
An open registry for interactive, web-native scientific articles with community peer review by threshold and citable DOIs via Zenodo. Authors self-publish at any URL and retain full ownership. The infrastructure Chris Olah identified as missing when Distill went on indefinite hiatus in 2021.
**Keywords:** Python, JavaScript, Open Source, Scientific Publishing

### Corrillo — Everyone's socials. One circle.
**Status:** Active (2026–)
**URL:** https://corrillo.app
Gives every group chat one shared page. Someone makes a circle and drops its link or QR code in the chat, everyone adds their socials once, and each person opens everyone else's profiles in one tap while a progress ring counts how many they have opened. No accounts, no installs, just a link. Circles delete themselves when they end. Built with React, TypeScript and Supabase (Postgres RPCs, realtime broadcast, Edge Functions), with Stripe Checkout for paid Event circles and an installable PWA.
**Keywords:** React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Stripe, PWA

### Sentinel — A FICO-like Health Index for Companies, Built Only from Their Treasury Trail
**Status:** Completed (2026)
**URL:** https://hack-spain.vercel.app
Built for HackSpain 2026 with Rubén Godoy and Walter J.T.V. Turns 2.6M bank movements and 0.9M invoices from 1,286 companies into a 0–100 monthly index, explained in euros, with alerts that name an owner and an action, control-chart monitoring, a 6-month forecast fan, and a chat agent that only answers from tool results. Explainable and monitorable by design, not a claim of prediction.
**Keywords:** Python, DuckDB, Next.js, Postgres, LLM Agents, Explainability

### Global Shapers Valencia — World Economic Forum Community Hub (Curator)
**Status:** Active (Jun 2025–)
**URL:** https://www.globalshapers.org
The Global Shapers Community is a World Economic Forum network of young leaders under 30, active in 400+ cities worldwide. Joined the Valencia Hub as a Shaper in June 2025; appointed Incoming Curator in December 2025. Took on the Curator role — the Hub's top leadership position — in June 2026.
**Keywords:** WEF, Community, Leadership, Valencia

### Bankinter Innovation Foundation — AI Mentor & Project Evaluator
**Status:** Active (Oct 2023–)
**URL:** https://www.fundacionbankinter.org
Mentored student teams in the Akademia programme (2023–2025) on AI algorithm development and model architecture. Currently serving on the 2026 expert panel to evaluate project proposals.
**Keywords:** AI, Mentorship, Innovation, Evaluation

### Valencia Fallas Route Optimization
**Status:** Completed (2024)
**URL:** https://www.linkedin.com/posts/javier-boix-campos_quina-%C3%A9s-la-ruta-perfecta-per-a-visitar-totes-activity-7176703931497017344-DU8H
Applied metaheuristics algorithms to optimise walking routes for visiting Valencia's Fallas festival — a network of 800+ monuments spread across the city. The project attracted local media coverage and demonstrated how combinatorial optimisation applies to real-world civic problems.
**Keywords:** Python, Optimisation, VBA, Metaheuristics

### Freelance AI/ML Consulting
**Status:** Active (2023–)
Occasional freelance engagements in machine learning, data analysis, and AI development. Projects span model development, custom pipelines, and technical consulting.
**Keywords:** Python, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Consulting

### Pain & Nutrition Tracker SaaS
**Status:** Completed (2025)
**URL:** https://hippocrate-care.fr
A full-stack Django application deployed with Docker and Nginx. Features advanced nutritional algorithms, multi-API orchestration, and AI-driven meal recognition for systematic healthcare monitoring.
**Keywords:** Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Python, Healthcare AI

### WhatsApp Chat Analyzer
**Status:** Completed (2023)
**URL:** https://whatsapp-analysis-tool.streamlit.app/
An interactive web application that parses WhatsApp chat histories to generate insightful visualizations. Built with Streamlit and Plotly, utilizing statistics techniques to identify communication trends.
**Keywords:** PyTorch, Statistics, Streamlit, Plotly, OpenCV
